name: alipbcs/ZetaRay
description: Hobby real-time Direct3D 12 path tracer implementing hardware-accelerated DXR ray tracing, ReSTIR sampling, AMD FSR2 upscaling, and glTF scene support for learning and experimenting with current-gen RT research.
score_rationale: 380-star DX12 path tracer demonstrating current-gen RT techniques like ReSTIR; useful learning reference for D3D12 ray tracing.
summary: DX12 path tracer with ReSTIR sampling and FSR2 upscaling research implementation
